PLAN "1-Week Deload Prior to Intensification"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Deload: reduce volume and intensity after hypertrophy block"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload A":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_curl 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Deload B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dip 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          tricep_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Deload C":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          front_squat 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Deload D":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 2x4..6 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
          abdominal_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 45m "Deload E":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          hollow_hold 2x20 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
          lower_back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Deload Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          walking_lunge 2x6..8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          box_step 2x8..10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_light_stretch 5 minutes
      DAY Sunday rest
   


SYNTAX RULES:
- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12` or `3x8-10`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.
